title: Motegi Control Tower
scope: The standing race control tower on the first paddock at Mobility Resort Motegi, including its distinct pale upper box, open roof deck and flank access stair.
limitations: Models the standalone control tower. The adjacent long pit garages and the separate speedway buildings sit outside scope.
The inset stair framing and facade colors follow the 2008 photograph. Rear openings, small equipment and exact floor heights are approximate.
